stage_io.text: Confirm the **{port}** output is up on {device}{feeds}.
Check the head-amp gain, +48V and pad for **{port}** on {device}.
Check the link/sync lights on {device}'s **{port}** port.
Check that {device} is locked to the console's clock (sync indicator steady, no sample-rate mismatch).

console.text: On {device}, check that the bus feeding **{port}** is unmuted, its fader is up and the channels are assigned to it.
On {device}, confirm **{port}** is patched to the channel you expect and the channel is unmuted.
Check whether a recent scene or show recall on {device} changed the patch, mutes or bus sends.
On {device}, pull down the channel or bus that rings, then check mic placement and monitor levels before raising it again.

video_switcher.text: Check levels on the {device}'s Program meter before it reaches {next_device}.
Make sure the right source is on Program on {device} and **{port}** is set to Program, not Preview or Multiview.
Check that the source on **{port}** matches {device}'s video format (resolution and frame rate).
If you rely on embedded audio from **{port}**, check the source actually sends audio on it and {device} has that input on or AFV.

stream.text: In the streaming software for {device}, confirm the input is **{port}** and its audio is not muted.
Check the stream health and preview on {device}; if the preview is fine, the problem is after the encoder (platform or network).

speaker.text: Check that {device} (or its amplifier) is powered and its input level is up.
If **{port}** links to another speaker, check the thru cable and that {device} is powered so it passes the signal on.
Check {device} for limit or protect indicators and listen for a damaged driver.

fixture.text: Check {device}'s DMX address and mode match the patch, and that the DMX signal LED is lit.
Check {device} has power (display lit) and the power link from the previous fixture is seated.
Check the DMX thru from {device} **{port}** to {next_device}; one bad fixture in the chain can stop everything after it.

source.text: Check that {device} is playing and its **{port}** output level is up (not muted, volume not at zero).
Make sure {device} is powered on and not asleep or in standby.

mic.text: Check the mute switch, batteries and capsule on {device}.
If {device} is a condenser, make sure +48V phantom power is on for the input it feeds on {next_device}.

computer.text: On {device}, check the selected audio/video output is **{port}** and the system volume is up.
Check the playback or capture software on {device} is running and pointed at the right interface; restart it if it stalled.

iem.text: Check {device}'s transmitter and bodypack are on the same frequency (group/channel) and the RF output is not muted.
Check the input level on {device} **{port}** and that the mix feeding it on the console is up.

pa.text: Check that {device} is powered, not in protect or limit, and its input level is up.
Check that {device} is listening to **{port}** (analog vs network input selection).

network.text: Check the link light on {device} **{port}** and that the port is enabled and on the right VLAN.
Check {device} is powered and, for PoE devices, that the switch port supplies PoE.

video.text: Check that {device} and **{port}** agree on resolution and frame rate.
Check the signal-present indicator on {device} for **{port}**.

other.text: Check that {device} is powered and its indicators look normal.
Check {device}'s front panel or software for a fault or status message on **{port}**.

wireless_rx.text: On {device}, check the RF meters for **{port}** and that the transmitter is on the same frequency.
Check {device}'s output level for **{port}** (mic/line switch, attenuation) and that the output is not muted.

processor.text: In {device}'s DSP design, check the signal path to **{port}** (mutes, gains, matrix crosspoints) is active.
Check the input meter for **{port}** in {device}'s software; no meter means the problem is upstream.

amp.text: Check {device} is powered, not in protect or thermal shutdown, and its channel is unmuted.
Check that {device} uses **{port}** as the input for that channel and its attenuator is up.

recorder.text: On {device}, check **{port}** is armed or enabled and its meter moves.
Check {device} has free storage and is actually recording (timer running).

intercom.text: Check the intercom channel on {device} is assigned and its talk/listen keys are on.
Check that the intercom line powering {device} is live (power supply or main station on).

camera.text: Check {device}'s output format on **{port}** matches the switcher or router input.
Check {device} is powered (PoE or DC) and not in standby.

video_source.text: Check that {device} is actually playing and **{port}** is its active output.
Check {device}'s output resolution and frame rate on **{port}**.

video_router.text: On {device}, check the crosspoint routed to **{port}** and that the output is not locked to another source.
Check {device} sees signal on **{port}** (input status in the router software).

converter.text: Check that {device} supports the format arriving on **{port}** and its switches or settings match.

encoder.text: In {device}, check the active input is **{port}** and its audio is enabled.
Check {device}'s network uplink and stream key / destination settings.

display.text: Check {device} is set to input **{port}** (use the remote's Source or Input button).
Check {device} is powered on and not in sleep or eco mode.

projector.text: Check {device} is on input **{port}** and the shutter / AV mute is open.
Check {device}'s lamp or laser status and its error LEDs.

lighting_console.text: On {device}, check the output for **{port}** is enabled and mapped to the right universe.
Check {device} is not in blackout, the grand master is up and the right show file is loaded.

dmx_node.text: Check {device} maps the right universe to **{port}** and its port LED shows data.
Check {device} receives data on **{port}** (sACN / Art-Net / DMX input LED).

dimmer.text: Check {device} receives DMX (data LED) and its start address matches the patch.
Check the breaker or module for that circuit on {device} is on and not tripped.

switch.text: Check the switch port for **{port}** on {device} is up, on the right VLAN and not error-disabled.
Check IGMP snooping, QoS and EEE settings on {device} for Dante / AV-over-IP traffic.

control.text: Check {device} is online and its program is running (reboot it if the touch panels show offline).
Check the control cable from {device} **{port}** and the controlled device's settings (baud rate, IP address, IR code).

touch_panel.text: Check {device} shows connected to its control processor (not offline).
Try the action again from {device}'s main page; if nothing happens, reboot the panel.

power.text: Check outlet **{port}** on {device} is switched on and its breaker is not tripped.
Check {device}'s input power and status display (on battery, overload, fault).

patch_panel.text: Re-seat the patch at {device} **{port}** and check the front and rear terminations.
Confirm {device} **{port}** goes where its label says (tone or test the run).
